hotels.title: Busselton Self-Contained Beachfront Apartments near Margaret River Wine Region
hotels.description: Experience the laidback vibes of one of Australia’s most famous food and wine regions with a stay at The Sebel Busselton - a hidden sanctuary nestled on Western Australia’s pristine southern coastline. Located in beachside Busselton, the resort is the perfect spot for a getaway in the Margaret River region. With nearby award-winning wineries, cellar doors and chef-hatted restaurants, endless beaches and two onsite pools for the kids, there’s something for everyone on this escape. Busselton’s pristine shores and crystal-clear waters overlooking Geographe Bay - home to the historic Busselton Jetty - are primed for fishing, snorkelling, sailing and scuba diving. And within close reach, you can discover the beauty of Margaret River, home to some of the country’s best wineries, restaurants and markets.
